item.subject: science
item.stem: During a science class in her school in Jaipur, Meena looked at a drop of pond water under a microscope and saw tiny moving organisms. Her teacher asked the class which statement about living organisms is correct. Which one should Meena choose?

options.A: Only large plants and animals are made of cells; tiny bacteria are not cell-based organisms
options.B: All living organisms are made up of cells; some organisms have only one cell while others have many cells
options.C: Every microscopic organism consists of exactly one cell
options.D: A unicellular organism like Amoeba is not made of cells because it is too small
